description: A control that opens a floating list of options and shows the chosen one in its trigger.
overview:
`Select` is built on the select primitive. `SelectTrigger` is a pressable field with the `combobox` role and an up-down caret. `SelectContent` renders in a portal, positioned next to the trigger, and fades in and out with Reanimated. The list matches the trigger width.

The trigger comes in two sizes, `default` and `sm`. Use Select for picking one value from a short list; for a list that needs searching, use Combobox.
usage:
Put a `SelectValue` inside `SelectTrigger`, and `SelectItem` entries inside `SelectContent`. Group items with `SelectGroup` and `SelectLabel`, and divide groups with `SelectSeparator`.

Control the value with `value` and `onValueChange` on `Select`, or start from `defaultValue`. Pass the full option list as `items` so `SelectValue` can show the label of the current value. `Select` also accepts `multiple`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange`.

Give each `SelectItem` a `value` and a `label`; the label is shown when no children are passed. `SelectValue` shows `placeholder` until a value is chosen. The `Option` type (`{ value, label }`) is also exported.

examples.WithValue: A select that starts with a chosen value.
examples.Grouped: Two labeled groups divided by a separator.
examples.WithLabel: A select labeled by a `Label` through `accessibilityLabelledBy`, with helper text.
examples.Disabled: A disabled select with a value.
examples.Invalid: The invalid state with an error message.
examples.OpenByDefault: A select whose list starts open.

parts.Select: Root that holds the value and open state.
parts.SelectTrigger: Pressable field that opens the list.
parts.SelectValue: Shows the selected label or the placeholder.
parts.SelectContent: Floating list rendered in a portal.
parts.SelectItem: One option, with a check mark when selected.

SelectTrigger.invalid: Shows the danger border. Falls back to the invalid state of an enclosing field.

SelectContent.side: Side of the trigger to open on. Defaults to `bottom`.
SelectContent.sideOffset: Gap from the trigger in points. Defaults to `4`.
SelectContent.align: Alignment against the trigger. Defaults to `center`.
SelectContent.alignOffset: Offset along the alignment axis. Defaults to `0`.
SelectContent.portalHost: Name of the portal host to render into.

accessibility:
- The trigger has the `combobox` role and reports its expanded and disabled states.
- The list has the `list` role; each item has the `option` role, uses its label as `accessibilityLabel` and reports selected and disabled states.
- Groups have the `group` role and are labeled by their `SelectLabel`.
- Label the trigger with `accessibilityLabelledBy` pointing at a `Label`'s `nativeID`, or with `accessibilityLabel`.
- The Android back button and the VoiceOver escape gesture close the list.
notes:
- Uses `bg-control` for the trigger, `bg-surface-raised` for the list and `text-link` for the check mark; colors follow the system appearance.
- On iOS the list renders inside a `FullWindowOverlay` from `react-native-screens`, so it appears above native modals.
